intro: Comar's Heart is a macabre ritual component carved from Comar Villard, a faithful human wanderer searching the marshes of the Wetlands for his lost wife. Forsaken warlocks in the Undercity seek out this relic of pure devotion to feed the summoning rites of a succubus.

p: To bind a creature as capricious and predatory as a succubus, warlocks must bait the demon with true purity and devotion. Carendin Halgar's disciples in the Undercity identify Comar Villard as one of the few men possessing such unblemished fidelity. While his wife was lost amidst the turmoil sweeping the Eastern Kingdoms, Comar stubbornly wanders the sodden roads of the Wetlands, refusing to abandon his search. It is precisely this unwavering love that marks him for slaughter, turning his still-beating heart into the ideal lure for a demonic servant.
